42/S0.subgoal: Explain where system implementation fits in the interactive system development lifecycle and why the lecture focuses on prototyping and usability evaluation.

42/S1.subgoal: Explain the design-prototype-evaluate cycle and why quick prototyping and quick usability evaluation are needed.

42/S2.subgoal: Explain what a prototype is and how it can be discarded after testing or evolved into the final product.

42/S3.subgoal: Distinguish horizontal from vertical prototypes by the aspects of the interface they represent.

42/S4.subgoal: Describe low-fidelity prototyping using interface sketches and storyboards to test appearance and interaction.

42/S5.subgoal: Describe medium- and high-fidelity prototyping approaches and their typical uses.

42/S6.subgoal: Explain the Wizard of Oz prototyping approach and how it can test an idea before the technology exists.

42/S7.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the next part.
